storyCards.headline: Southern Cross: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Crosby, Stills's "Southern Cross" reached #18 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #18 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Southern Cross was released in 1982.
